description.value: Gratia is a community-focused cafe and bakery that evolved from its original Maple Ridge home (formerly Breads & Buns, est. 2016) and opened this Langley outpost in May 2021 in the Walnut Grove neighbourhood. It serves house-baked breads, rotating sandwiches and paninis on housemade loaves, a daily soup, and a full specialty espresso and tea drink menu. Outdoor seating is available, and the kitchen's emphasis on fresh, adaptable ingredients makes it a worthwhile stop for cyclists crossing the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at gratiabakery.com/langley confirms the business is open, provides a corroborating address (20330 88 Ave Langley City, BC, V1M 2Y4) and phone number (604) 881-2170 absent from OSM, and explicitly states dine-in and take-out availability. The food menu labels vegetarian items with (V) and the site notes items are 'adaptable to your dietary needs.' No mention of bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone (604) 881-2170 sourced from website only.
OSM name is 'Gratia Cafe' but the brand presents itself simply as 'Gratia' on its website — minor discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active cafe with takeout, outdoor seating, and vegetarian-friendly menu in a cyclist-accessible Langley location; a practical food and drink stop for touring cyclists.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'We offer a limited number of dine-in and take-out items.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly marks vegetarian items with (V), including Grilled Four Cheese and Avocado, Mozzarella & Pesto; site notes menu items are 'adaptable to your dietary needs.'
